title: BundleValidationError — required input absent
problem: A mandatory mapped value is missing from the input bundle.

likely_causes.cause: A mandatory mapped value is missing from the input bundle.

diagnosis_steps: Check the named field and its upstream value in the failing bundle; compare a successful bundle.

solutions.solution: Correct the mapping or supply the missing business data.
solutions.conditions: Only after identifying the required field and confirming the intended value; never invent a placeholder.

audit_notes: Documentation checked; diagnostic procedure is editorial. No resolved production case. Scores are editorial, not measured probabilities. Error types are identifiers, not complete execution messages.

evidence.claim: A mandatory mapped value is missing from the input bundle.

title: AccountValidationError — initialization authentication failure
problem: Connection authentication fails during initialization; a module error handler cannot catch this phase.

likely_causes.cause: Connection authentication fails during initialization; a module error handler cannot catch this phase.

diagnosis_steps: Request the exact error, initialization phase and connection name without credentials. Compare recent connection changes.

solutions.solution: Review the connection credentials with the account owner; reconnect if invalid.
solutions.conditions: Only when authentication failure is confirmed; a bare HTTP 401 does not establish initialization failure.

audit_notes: Documentation checked; diagnostic procedure is editorial. No resolved production case. Scores are editorial, not measured probabilities. Error types are identifiers, not complete execution messages.

evidence.claim: Connection authentication fails during initialization; a module error handler cannot catch this phase.

title: Data store — values inaccessible after field rename
problem: Renaming a structure field changes its identifier; existing values can become inaccessible.
symptoms: Data store — values inaccessible after field rename

likely_causes.cause: Renaming a structure field changes its identifier; existing values can become inaccessible.

diagnosis_steps: Compare old and new field names, labels and a saved record. Request a backup before structural changes.

solutions.solution: Restore access using the original field name, then plan a backed-up migration.
solutions.conditions: Only for a confirmed field-name change; a label-only change or a different store needs another diagnosis.

audit_notes: Documentation checked; diagnostic procedure is editorial. No resolved production case. Scores are editorial, not measured probabilities. Error types are identifiers, not complete execution messages.

evidence.claim: Renaming a structure field changes its identifier; existing values can become inaccessible.

title: Scenario — ordered processing waits for incomplete executions
problem: Ordered processing can hold new runs while incomplete executions remain unresolved.
symptoms: Scenario — ordered processing waits for incomplete executions

likely_causes.cause: Ordered processing can hold new runs while incomplete executions remain unresolved.

diagnosis_steps: Inspect the ordering setting, pending executions and their timestamps; distinguish waiting from deactivation.

solutions.solution: Investigate and resolve the blocking incomplete execution manually.
solutions.conditions: Only when ordered processing and pending executions are confirmed; assess previous writes before retrying.

audit_notes: Documentation checked; diagnostic procedure is editorial. No resolved production case. Scores are editorial, not measured probabilities. Error types are identifiers, not complete execution messages.

evidence.claim: Ordered processing can hold new runs while incomplete executions remain unresolved.

title: First module — failed execution missing from storage
problem: A first-module failure is not stored automatically merely by enabling incomplete executions; Retry provides the documented exception.
symptoms: First module — failed execution missing from storage

likely_causes.cause: A first-module failure is not stored automatically merely by enabling incomplete executions; Retry provides the documented exception.

diagnosis_steps: Confirm the failing module is first, storage is enabled and available, and inspect its handler.

solutions.solution: Configure a Retry handler on the first module and review its completion settings.
solutions.conditions: Only for a catchable first-module failure; this does not restore an already absent execution or repair authentication.

audit_notes: Documentation checked; diagnostic procedure is editorial. No resolved production case. Scores are editorial, not measured probabilities. Error types are identifiers, not complete execution messages.

evidence.claim: A first-module failure is not stored automatically merely by enabling incomplete executions; Retry provides the documented exception.

title: Aggregator — upstream fields unavailable downstream
problem: Fields inside the aggregation scope are unavailable downstream unless included in the aggregation output.

likely_causes.cause: Fields inside the aggregation scope are unavailable downstream unless included in the aggregation output.

diagnosis_steps: Compare source, aggregation scope, selected fields and output schema with the downstream mapping.

solutions.solution: Include the needed fields in the aggregator setup and map its output.
solutions.conditions: Only when the required values exist upstream but are omitted from aggregation; verify downstream shape before changing mapping.
